correctness.rationale: Under continuous edge priorities, independent hub-avoiding path components factor; the first-edge recurrence (2k−1)p_k=Σ p_i p_(k−2−i) gives the exact wheel probability. Its even-index convolution linearizes to F=−4U′/U with U entire. The positive-coefficient complement D=1−U has unique positive rho and, by triangle-equality strictness from the first two positive coefficients, no other zero on the circle |z|=rho. The simple pole has coefficient 4, yielding q_(2m)=2rho^(−m)+O(R^(−m)); exact rational bounds certify rho. The embedded independent finite-state checker passed 58 assertions, including exhaustive 8! priority orders for W4. Finite tests corroborate rather than prove the asymptotic; Cauchy estimates and zero exclusion complete it.

value.rationale: The wheel hub is an especially natural high-degree exceptional vertex in random sequential dimer adsorption; typical-vertex limits are silent on its survival. The result explains a parity obstruction, gives all-size rational probabilities, and identifies both an exact exponential decay base and nontrivial leading coefficient for the rare event. Such exact tail calibration is meaningful structural information on a canonical infinite graph family rather than a routine reparameterization or tiny finite table.
